events.title: Dev Log Preview: March of the Druids
events.summary: Druids are an enemy that become more of a nuisance the longer they survive. Starting from level 1, they are able to periodically transform into their bear form making them much more deadlier. While in bear-form, druids have additional temporary health, increased movement speed and increased attack damage! events.title: Narrative Update + Hero Ability Rework for new Demo Patch
events.summary: Narrative and Player TipsThe full-release is planned to include a meta-narrative that spans across runs and explores some of the relationships between the different bosses as well as the history of the Shareholders and its company. Much of this will be explored through short pre-combat dialog scenes that will progress the story as the player faces each boss over multiple runs. The demo now includes some narrative events for the demo bosses.This system is also utilized to help provide useful tips
